method: Spec conformance, round 1, 2026-10-26. The picked mockups are linked (file symlinks) from design-explorations/, not copied. Each was opened with the Read image tool in this session before writing its row.

screenshots.screen_state: Capture bar / default, New Area chosen, Session / light / 100%
screenshots.observations: Two-row bar at the bottom centre. Headline 'Capture Area' with hint 'Drag to choose the area'. Segmented Session | One-Shot and a session pop-up at the right. Esc, five modes with labels and keys 1-5, Options with a key hint, one blue 'Capture ↩'. The chosen mode has a grey fill and blue icon. Only Capture is filled blue. Area outline dashed blue.

issues.summary: Mode 2 reads 'Capture Area', while ⌃⇧4 is 'Capture Last Area'; one place, two near names
issues.quote: - **WRD-4 (accepted).** One word per thing, everywhere: session, screenshot, mark, reference, card, Discarded.

screenshots.screen_state: Capture bar / Record chosen, Options menu open / dark / 100%
screenshots.observations: Headline 'Record', hint 'Up to 30 seconds'. Options menu: Save to (Session, One-Shot), Frame rate (15, 10 checked, 5, 4, 2 fps), Timer (None, 3, 5, 10 seconds), Show Mouse Pointer. Record fill is grey with a blue icon. Capture stays the only blue fill. Dark material legible.

issues.summary: Options ▸ Save to repeats the Session | One-Shot segmented control in the same bar
issues.proposal: DST-1: the destination has one control per surface, the Session | One-Shot segmented control; no menu repeats it.

issues.summary: Group header 'Frame rate' is sentence case; macOS menus head groups in title case like 'Frame Rate'
issues.quote: - **WRD-1 (accepted).** Menus, buttons, tabs and window titles use title case, as macOS does. Headings, labels, placeholders and messages use sentence case.

screenshots.observations: Screen dimmed outside the area. A frosted square centred on the area with a large '3' and 'Esc cancels'. The menu bar shows the Snapmark icon with '3' beside it. Bar is gone. Digit is legible against the frosted fill.
Dark panel below the area: a round grey stop button, '0:07 of 0:30 · 10 fps', blue 'Done ↩', 'Esc cancels'. The area outline is solid blue. The panel sits outside the area.

issues.summary: The stop button and Done do the same thing; two controls for one action
issues.proposal: One control per action in a capture panel: a red dot shows recording; Done is the only stop.

screenshots.observations: Toolbar: tools with ⌘ keys, colour swatch, Undo ⌘Z, Redo ⇧⌘Z, grey segmented Session | One-Shot with Session selected in blue text, pop-up 'Ledgerly Q4 review (6)'. A grey line 'Ledgerly Q4 review · 6 screenshots' sits under the pop-up. Notes column: 'General comment' with room above, a hairline, 'References' with two notes. Footer Discard ⌘W and blue 'Add to Session ⌘↩'. Copy or Save button is not drawn.

issues.summary: The grey line under the pop-up repeats the pop-up's name and count
issues.proposal: A control's face is its only label; no caption repeats it.

screenshots.observations: Native menu under the pop-up: four sessions with counts, a check on 'Ledgerly Q4 review (6)', separator, 'Older Sessions…', 'New Session ⌃⇧N'. The menu covers the notes column top; acceptable for a transient menu.

screenshots.screen_state: Recording editor / key frames, two references / light / 100%
screenshots.observations: Canvas: 'Recording 0:03.2 · 10 fps · 32 frames', 'Key frames 4 of 32 frames', 'Show all 32 frames ⌥A'. Four frames in a row labelled 0.0 s Page, 0.4 s Spinner appears, 2.4 s Rows appear, 3.2 s Settled. Two references with times in the notes. A 'Recording' block repeats the facts in the notes column. Previous frame / Next frame links. Toolbar ends with a link '→ Ledgerly Q4 review ⌘⇧O', not the picked destination controls. Primary reads 'Add to session'.

issues.summary: The toolbar lacks the picked Session | One-Shot control and pop-up
issues.quote: - At the right end of the toolbar, after Undo/Redo: a grey segmented control `Session | One-Shot` (selected: grey fill, blue text), then a pop-up button `<session> (<count>) ⌄`.

issues.summary: Primary button 'Add to session' is sentence case
issues.quote: - **WRD-1 (accepted).** Menus, buttons, tabs and window titles use title case, as macOS does. Headings, labels, placeholders and messages use sentence case.

issues.summary: Frame captions like 'Spinner appears' cannot be known by Snapmark
issues.proposal: Key frames carry their time only; any caption is the owner's note.

issues.summary: The notes column 'Recording' block repeats the canvas facts line
issues.proposal: Facts appear once per window; the notes column holds notes only.

screenshots.screen_state: Session window / Screenshots, recording entry / light / 100%
screenshots.observations: Header tabs Document ⌘1, Screenshots ⌘2, Discarded 3 ⌘3, Open in Markdown App ⇧⌘M. Entry 007 badge 'Recording', '0:03.2 · 10 fps · 32 frames', Edit Again ⌘O. 'Filmstrip · for AI PNG' with four frames and marks; 'GIF · for people' with Play Space. Notes with times. Neighbour entry 006 Screenshot.

issues.summary: Tab keys ⌘1–⌘3 and ⇧⌘M appear, which no rule or spec defines
issues.proposal: Do not add tab keys in this change; record them as a separate ask if wanted.
